# ShaderX

> Kotlin Multiplatform shader effects for Jetpack Compose and Compose Multiplatform.

Documentation target and stable release coordinate: io.github.debanshu777:shaderx:0.2.0.
Publication follows the release commit; verify the overview publication-status note and Central
metadata before claiming the coordinate is available. Central 0.1.4 was last verified on 2026-11-20.
No beta stage is planned. The changelog owns release history and migration owns upgrade actions.
Android minSdk 31 supports native blur; AGSL operations require API 33+. The library AAR uses
minCompileSdk 35 and Java 17 bytecode; contributors use JDK 21. Kotlin packages use
com.debanshu.shaderlab.shaderx.

ShaderX 0.2.0 provides ShaderDefinition/ShaderProgram/ShaderBinding, strict schemas, controlled
playback/live revisions, EffectCollection, capabilities/fallback, ordered Skia on-screen chains,
procedural backgrounds, data/nested inputs and bounded/suspend Skia PNG export. Ordinary session
animation, texture uniforms, animated/audio built-ins and manual runtime interfaces remain supported.
Review exhaustive Uniform/enum handlers when upgrading. Keep the historical frozen JVM baseline
separate from the latest-stable audit; JVM linkage does not establish Android/Klib binary compatibility.
Public Android image export and offline composites remain unsupported. Portable numerical
sampling is limited to 64 texels; native Skia raw-image sampling and public Brush ownership
remain absent/deferred. See the platform guide for operation-specific limits.

Core coroutine 1.10.2 supports suspend export; optional Coil 3.4.0/Haze 1.7.2 recipes do not add
loader/backdrop dependencies to core. Raster/emulator/source validation does not prove physical
GPU performance, universal concurrency or native-memory stabilization.

## Source and availability

- [Repository and Markdown guides](https://github.com/Debanshu777/ShaderX)
- [Published releases](https://github.com/Debanshu777/ShaderX/releases)
- [Maven Central release](https://central.sonatype.com/artifact/io.github.debanshu777/shaderx)

Markdown in the release checkout is the source for the documented contracts; hosted
links may still describe an earlier deployment. External manual effects implement
RuntimeShaderEffect/AnimatedShaderEffect. Internal abstract bases require inaccessible handlers.
